channel.title: The Mary Sue - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Mary Sue (themarysue.com)

item.title: ‘Who would’ve thought?’: Woman buys $60 Dior Saddle Bag dupe from Canal Street in New York. Then she shows why she should’ve only paid $20
item.description: In a viral video, a woman sparked controversy after unveiling how long her Dior Saddle Bag from Canal Street dupe lasted.

item.title: Starbucks barista draws John Pork meme on LASD officer’s cup. Then they get fired: ‘Cops are so sensitive’
item.description: Starbucks let go of a barista who gave a police officer a cup with a 'John Pork' drawing on it. Here's how viewers are reacting.

item.title: Woman with $22 to her name orders croissant, coffee at birthday brunch. She wasn’t ready for the bill to be split evenly: ’It’s $118 each’
item.description: TikTok user Flor (@sidehustleswithflor) has gone viral after sharing how she was expected to pay $118 for a birthday brunch.

item.title: San Diego social media expert helps man become an influencer. Then he dumps her: ‘I truly thought we were building a life together’
item.description: One woman's video about a doomed relationship has gone viral, sparking debate on dating in today's social media era.

item.title: Woman goes to her ‘favorite’ coffee shop weekly to study for the MCAT. Then a barista kicks her out for not buying anything. So who was in the right?
item.description: A local coffee shop and one of its regulars are trading words on TikTok after the customer was allegedly kicked out for not buying anything.

item.title: ‘Please bring a sandwich and a chair’: Bride sends out her wedding invitations. Then she receives a shocking anonymous letter
item.description: A bride’s wedding RSVP wording sparks backlash after she receives an anonymous letter complete with taped 'sandwiches' and 'chairs.'

item.title: Woman wants designer shopping bag but doesn’t want to spend $125. Then she finds out Aldi has a $30 dupe: ‘Target has one for $12’
item.description: In a viral video, a woman takes viewers on an adventure through Aldi in search of a Hulken bag dupe for $30.

item.title: Man walks into Hermes with no purchase history. That didn’t stop them from taking him to the VIP room: ‘Consumerismcore?’
item.description: A TikToker managed to get into one of Hermès's VIP rooms despite having no prior purchasing history. Most viewers said it wasn't a flex.

item.title: An Australian woman gets her lip filler dissolved. Then she’s rushed to the hospital in an ambulance: 'Did they dissolve it with a baseball bat?'
item.description: A TikToker shares her experience with a severe allergic reaction after dissolving her lip filler. Viewers can't believe what she looked like.

item.title: 35yo Texas woman ‘grossly abused tanning beds’ in her teens. This $8 serum from Trader Joe’s has saved her from ‘crepey neck’
item.description: A Texas woman says the $8 Trader Joe's retinol serum may have saved her thousands on expensive treatments after it fixed her 'crepey' skin.
